description: The full loop, end to end. One coffee purchase, up through the distributor and the manufacturer, all the way to the endgame: things get cheaper locally first, then the effect scales outward until the dollar gets routed around instead of destroyed. Paychecks keep working through the transition. The final boss is the state layer. Part 4 of The Engine in Plain Words.

summary: The full loop end to end: one coffee purchase up the supply chain to the endgame, where the dollar gets routed around and the ledger takes over. Part 4 of The Engine in Plain Words.
title: The Engine in Plain Words Part 4: How It All Connects
